events.title: DADCORE is in Steam Next Fest! Play the free demo with the dev
events.summary: Steam Next Fest is on, and the DADCORE demo is free. It stays up after the festival too. DADCORE: midlife crisis with friends. A physics based co-op survival game for up to 4 players. events.title: Update: the forest burns now
events.summary: The final DADCORE demo build for Steam Next Fest is live. WHAT'S NEW The forest burns now. Hold a lighter to a tree, a bush or the pier, and the fire spreads from tree to tree, setting dads and barrels alight. The lake puts you out, and the fire dies down on its own. The Music slider now turns off all music, the boombox and fanfares too. Handy for streams. If the host crashes or leaves, you go back to the main menu instead of getting stuck. events.title: The DADCORE demo is out! Play a midlife crisis with friends!
events.summary: The DADCORE demo is out, and it's free. DADCORE is a physics based midlife crisis simulator for up to 4 friends. The dads went away for a fishing weekend. IN THE DEMO A camping weekend at the lake. Tent, logs, fire. Go fishing. Catch it, grill it, sell it. Drive to the shop in the woods. Real fire. The grill lights the tent, the tent lights a dad.
